headline: Public hearings on a 3-lot subdivision at 107 Chestnut Street and a 68,400 sq. ft. manufacturing building at 681 Clark Avenue.
summary: The Chestnut Street subdivision hearing was continued from October 26, 2026. A referral on earth removal for a home lot on Grassy Road is also up for review.
items: Public hearing: 3-lot subdivision at 107 Chestnut Street, continued from October 26, 2026
Public hearing: site plan for a 68,400 sq. ft. manufacturing building at 681 Clark Avenue

Zoning Commission referral: special permit and site plan for earth removal over 400 cubic yards for a residential lot on Grassy Road (Lot 215), including review of scenic resources in the 2018 Plan of Conservation and Development
Staff report: 2028 Bristol Plan of Conservation and Development
Staff report: subdivision status report for November 2026
location: City Hall, Council Chambers, First Floor, 111 North Main Street
